name: preview-card-1f
title: Preview Card 1f: Ticket stub
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. A dashed tear line with notches cut into both sides, and the install slug on the stub.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
